projects.name: Raqcoin
projects.chart_note: Renamed in 2022; old Rainbow parameters broken
projects.milestone_note: The 2018 milestone is ABCMint genesis, not UOV deployment. Community materials describe a 2022 rename.
projects.signing_note: RainbowPro and UOV configurations; multisig is a separate capability.
projects.agility_note: Key configuration selects the signing scheme. Existing keys do not change automatically.
projects.caveat: The guide lists Rainbow configuration 274 as the default. Legacy ABCMint Rainbow parameters have a public break. New configurations require separate analysis; NIST UOV candidate parameters are not Raqcoin deployment parameters.

projects.name: Mochimo
projects.chart_note: Switched from PoW to PoS in Oct 2026
projects.consensus_note: PoS after the October 2026 migration; historically PoW.
projects.agility_note: One active signing scheme in the reviewed material.
projects.caveat: Consensus changed; the signing scheme remained WOTS+. No claim that a future protocol upgrade could never change it.

projects.name: QRL
projects.consensus_note: QRL 1.x mainnet uses PoW; QRL 2.0 PoS was a testnet in this snapshot.
projects.agility_note: Hash-function choice and descriptor fields; not arbitrary switching between signature families.
projects.caveat: XMSS is stateful. The RFC size example is not QRL transaction serialization.

projects.name: Nexus
projects.chart_note: Falcon is optional; Brainpool remains classical
projects.milestone_note: November 2019 is the Tritium upgrade, not the original chain genesis in 2014.
projects.signing_note: Opt-in Falcon-512; classical Brainpool signatures remain valid.
projects.agility_note: Signature chains commit to a subsequent key and scheme.
projects.caveat: Do not treat every Nexus account as post-quantum.

projects.name: Tidecoin
projects.chart_cryptography: Falcon-512 live; ML-DSA in upgrade code
projects.chart_note: Multi-scheme upgrade not active on mainnet
projects.consensus_note: PoW; the reviewed default mainnet parameters disable the AuxPoW activation gate.
projects.signing_note: Falcon-512 active; Falcon-1024 and ML-DSA exist in upgrade code.
projects.agility_note: Multiple schemes are implemented behind an activation gate.
projects.caveat: Implemented upgrade support does not establish that it is active on mainnet.

projects.name: Starknet
projects.milestone_note: November 2021 is L2 Mainnet Alpha, not an independent L1 launch.
projects.consensus_note: Ethereum L2 with a phased PoS rollout.
projects.signing_note: STARK validity proofs and a Falcon-512 account demonstration.
projects.agility_note: Account abstraction and contract upgrades can change account verification logic.
projects.caveat: A Falcon account demo is not migration of every account. Ethereum settlement and bridge dependencies remain. The L1 vote supported research, not a move.

projects.name: Abelian
projects.consensus_note: Dual PoW: ABEL-ETHash and ABEL-Nakamoto after the Aconcagua upgrade.
projects.agility_note: Versioned cryptographic schemes; mining algorithm choice is a separate matter.
projects.caveat: These schemes are not ML-DSA. Dual PoW does not mean PoW plus PoS. QDay is a separate L2.

projects.name: Algorand
projects.chart_note: Chain launched in 2019; consensus still classical
projects.milestone_note: The timeline uses the 2022 State Proofs milestone. The chain launched in 2019.
projects.signing_note: Falcon State Proofs and opt-in Falcon account authorization.
projects.agility_note: Rekeying and programmable authorization; native Falcon-1024 accounts are also documented.
projects.caveat: State Proofs and account signing have different roles. Consensus participation keys remain classical; app and wallet support still matters.

projects.name: Cellframe
projects.chart_note: Main chain: PoS; zerochain: PoA · CF-20 only
projects.consensus_note: PoS on the main transaction chain; PoA on the zerochain.
projects.signing_note: Native-wallet options include Dilithium, Falcon and SPHINCS+.
projects.agility_note: Multiple native signing schemes, subject to network and wallet support.
projects.caveat: Scope is native CF-20 assets, not ERC-20/BEP-20 tokens. Picnic is a historical/deprecated route, not a current wallet option in this release.

projects.name: QuantumCoin
projects.chart_note: Signing modes activate at protocol thresholds
projects.signing_note: Hybrid post-quantum and Ed25519 signing; ML-DSA and SLH-DSA components.
projects.agility_note: Signing modes change at protocol thresholds and in emergency mode.
projects.caveat: Do not assume every protocol phase uses exactly the same component combination. ML-KEM node handshakes are not transaction signatures.

projects.name: QANplatform
projects.chart_note: Testnet uses PoA; transition to PoS is planned
projects.milestone_note: May 2024 is the public testnet announcement, not a public mainnet launch.
projects.consensus_note: PoA on the reviewed public testnet; PoS is planned.
projects.agility_note: A fixed signature pairing in the reviewed XLINK path.
projects.caveat: The traded QANX token does not establish a live native post-quantum mainnet. The original 2024 announcement used the Dilithium name; do not backdate current parameters.

projects.name: Neptune Cash
projects.milestone_note: First launch in February 2025; the current chain relaunched on August 5, 2025.
projects.signing_note: Hash-preimage spending conditions and Triton STARK validity proofs.
projects.caveat: A STARK proof and a hash-preimage spending condition are not a fixed-size standard digital signature.

projects.name: Nervos CKB
projects.timeline_milestone: Jan · SPHINCS+ lock deployed on mainnet
projects.chart_note: Chain launched in 2019; existing funds must migrate
projects.milestone_note: January 2026 marks the SPHINCS+ lock deployment. CKB mainnet launched in 2019.
projects.agility_note: New verification logic can be deployed as lock scripts.
projects.caveat: Existing cells must satisfy their old spending rules before migration. Default secp256k1 cells do not change automatically.

projects.name: Quantus
projects.caveat: ML-DSA-65 requires runtime spec 139 or later and compatible account tooling. Quantus and qtcchain both use QTC but are separate chains.

projects.name: xCoin
projects.chart_note: Fallback key must be in the spending tree
projects.milestone_note: The project whitepaper dates mainnet genesis to September 26, 2026.
projects.signing_note: ML-DSA-65 primary signing; SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s fallback leaves.
projects.agility_note: Cross-family fallback requires committing to the alternative spending leaf in advance.
projects.caveat: This is not a claim that every spend carries both signatures or that a new fallback can be added after a key is compromised.

projects.name: qtcchain
projects.chart_note: Oct 5 v2 re-genesis; unrelated to Quantus
projects.milestone_note: v1 launched September 30, 2026; v2 re-genesis was October 5, 2026.
projects.agility_note: Per-key scheme selection and multiple script leaves.
projects.caveat: Falcon is reserved in the reviewed specification. qtcchain is unrelated to Quantus despite the shared QTC ticker. The repository records a v2 treasury allocation; inclusion is not a fair-launch endorsement.

projects.name: Soqucoin
projects.milestone_note: Mainnet block 1 was mined on October 13, 2026.
projects.agility_note: One active transaction-signing scheme in the snapshot.
projects.caveat: XMSS experiments are not counted as a mainnet signing path. Public blocks do not establish user adoption or independent security certification.
